reason: The plugin provides a local image-to-LaTeX OCR tool for converting screenshots, textbook formulas, and handwritten formula photos into LaTeX code.

summaries.zh: 将公式截图、教材页面或手写公式照片识别为 LaTeX 代码的本地 OCR 插件。
summaries.en: A local OCR plugin that converts formula screenshots, textbook pages, and handwritten formula photos into LaTeX code.

capabilities: Reads an image from a user-provided local path
Invokes the local pix2tex command-line tool through execFile
Produces LaTeX text from mathematical formula images
May download model weights during first use
